# Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

> The CDC is the leading U.S. federal agency for disease prevention, outbreak response, and public health guidance across infectious and chronic diseases.

CDC.gov provides authoritative public health information covering disease prevention, immunization schedules, outbreak tracking, and health screening resources. The site serves healthcare professionals, researchers, and the general public with evidence-based guidance on infectious diseases, chronic conditions, and emergency preparedness.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19
- Influenza
- Vaccination & Immunization
- Outbreak Response
- Disease Prevention
- Measles
- Long COVID
- Opioid Overdose Prevention
- Type 2 Diabetes
- High Blood Pressure
- Lyme Disease
- Handwashing & Hygiene
- Public Health
- Workplace Safety
- NIOSH

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov): CDC main portal with immunization, workplace safety, and disease outbreak information
- [Health Topics | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/health-topics.html): A-Z index of health topics covering diseases, conditions, and public health resources
- [CDC Current Outbreak List | Outbreaks | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/outbreaks/index.html): Current outbreak tracking and disease investigation resources including foodborne illness
- [About CDC | About CDC | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/about): CDC organization, leadership, mission, careers, and advisory committee information
- [Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/spanish): Spanish-language CDC portal with health topics and disease prevention resources

## Infectious Disease Prevention & Guidance

- [How to Protect Yourself and Others | COVID-19 | CDC](https://cdc.gov/covid/prevention/index.html): COVID-19 prevention guide including vaccination, testing, and respiratory protection
- [Signs and Symptoms of Flu | Influenza (Flu) | CDC](https://cdc.gov/flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Flu symptom identification, diagnosis, complications, and high-risk group information
- [About Measles | Measles (Rubeola) | CDC](https://cdc.gov/measles/about/index.html): Measles disease information with MMR vaccine protection and symptom guidance
- [Signs and Symptoms of Bird Flu in People | Bird Flu | CDC](https://cdc.gov/bird-flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Avian influenza H5 symptoms and signs in people with public health guidance
- [About Lyme Disease | Lyme Disease | CDC](https://cdc.gov/lyme/about/index.html): Lyme disease overview covering tick-borne transmission, prevention, and treatment
- [About Hantavirus | Hantavirus | CDC](https://cdc.gov/hantavirus/about/index.html): Hantavirus overview covering transmission, treatment, and pulmonary syndrome
- [Preventing Dengue | Dengue | CDC](https://cdc.gov/dengue/prevention): Dengue prevention through mosquito bite protection and insect repellent guidance

## Vaccination & Immunization

- [What Vaccines are Recommended for You | Adult Vaccines | CDC](https://cdc.gov/vaccines-adults/recommended-vaccines/index.html): Adult vaccination recommendations and routine immunization schedule guidance

## Chronic Disease Prevention & Management

- [Preventing Type 2 Diabetes | Diabetes | CDC](https://cdc.gov/diabetes/prevention-type-2/index.html): Type 2 diabetes prevention through National DPP program and lifestyle changes
- [About High Blood Pressure | High Blood Pressure | CDC](https://cdc.gov/high-blood-pressure/about/index.html): Hypertension overview with diagnosis guidelines and cardiovascular health information
- [Tips for Maintaining Healthy Weight | Healthy Weight and Growth | CDC](https://cdc.gov/healthy-weight-growth/about/tips-for-balancing-food-activity.html): Healthy weight maintenance tips covering nutrition, calories, and physical activity
- [About Alzheimer's | Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia | CDC](https://cdc.gov/alzheimers-dementia/about/alzheimers.html): Alzheimer's disease overview covering signs, symptoms, and affected populations

## Substance Use & Injury Prevention

- [Preventing Opioid Overdose | Overdose Prevention | CDC](https://cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/prevention/index.html): Opioid overdose prevention strategies addressing fentanyl crisis and substance use

## Health & Safety Facts

- [Handwashing Facts | Clean Hands | CDC](https://cdc.gov/clean-hands/data-research/facts-stats): Handwashing facts and statistics on disease prevention and germ transmission
